j1.what_the_patch_does: Adds pre-request validation that pages is at least 1 and per_page is between 1 and 100, plus tests for invalid and boundary values.
j1.reading_applied: Literal reading: the rule prohibits retrying after a bare HTTP 403 because it may be a permissions error.
j1.rationale: The patch neither handles 403 responses nor adds retry behavior; it only validates paging arguments before any request.

j2.what_the_patch_does: Adds early validation that pages is at least 1 and per_page is 1 through 100, with tests confirming invalid values make no request.
j2.reading_applied: The rule is read as prohibiting retries triggered by a bare HTTP 403, whether as a default or optional behavior.
j2.rationale: The patch contains no 403 handling or retry behavior; it only validates paging arguments before issuing requests. Therefore it does not do what the rule ruled out under either reading.
